---
title: "Data Transformations"
format: html
---

Data transformations are operations that take one data modality as input
and produce derived data for downstream analysis.

![Figure: 1) Feature select from available loaded data 2) Tranformation select Dialog box; 3) Output name of new data created by transformation; 4) Execution Button; 5) Parameter window for selected transformation](images/clipboard-2963664009.png)

- [Mask Transforms Reference](mask_transforms_reference.qmd)
- [Media Transforms Reference](media_transforms_reference.qmd)
- [Point Transforms Reference](point_transforms_reference.qmd)
- [Interval Transforms Reference](interval_transforms_reference.qmd)

## Complete Transform Table (Registry)

The table below is derived from the transform registry in source:
`src/DataManager/transforms/TransformRegistry.cpp`.

| Input Data | Transform | Output Data |
|---|---|---|
| Analog Time Series | Filter | Analog Time Series |
| Analog Time Series | Hilbert Phase | Analog Time Series |
| Analog Time Series | Scale and Normalize | Analog Time Series |
| Analog Time Series | Threshold Event Detection | Digital Event Series |
| Analog Time Series | Threshold Interval Detection | Digital Interval Series |
| Analog Time Series | Interval Peak Detection | Digital Event Series |
| Digital Interval Series | Group Intervals | Digital Interval Series |
| Digital Interval Series | Boolean Operation | Digital Interval Series |
| Line Data | Line Alignment to Bright Features | Line Data |
| Line Data | Calculate Line Angle | Analog Time Series |
| Line Data | Calculate Line to Point Distance | Analog Time Series |
| Line Data | Line Base Flip | Line Data |
| Line Data | Resample Line | Line Data |
| Line Data | Calculate Line Curvature | Analog Time Series |
| Line Data | Extract Line Subsegment | Line Data |
| Line Data | Extract Point from Line | Point Data |
| Line Data | Clip Line by Reference Line | Line Data |
| Line Data | Group Lines by Proximity | Line Data |
| Line Data | Group Lines using Kalman Filtering | Line Data |
| Line Data | Line Outlier Detection | Line Data |
| Line Data | Group Lines by Index | Line Data |
| Line Data | Line Group to Digital Intervals | Digital Interval Series |
| Mask Data | Calculate Area | Analog Time Series |
| Mask Data | Calculate Mask Centroid | Point Data |
| Mask Data | Remove Small Connected Components | Mask Data |
| Mask Data | Fill Mask Holes | Mask Data |
| Mask Data | Apply Median Filter | Mask Data |
| Mask Data | Calculate Mask Principal Axis | Line Data |
| Mask Data | Convert Mask To Line | Line Data |
| Mask Data | Skeletonize Mask | Mask Data |
| Point Data | Track Points Through Masks (Particle Filter) | Point Data |
| Media Data | Whisker Tracing | Line Data |

## Notes

- Grouping transforms (for example line grouping/outlier transforms) may
	preserve the `Line Data` modality while updating grouping assignments.
- Some registry transforms are listed here even if a dedicated user-guide
	page has not yet been written.
